php_scylladb_module(type ext_scylladb::type)

target_sources(type PRIVATE
        Collection.c
        Conversions.c
        Map.c
        Scalar.c
        Set.c
        Tuple.c
        TypeFactory.c
        UserType.c
        ValueHash.c
)

set(_type_stubs
        Collection.stub.php
        Set.stub.php
        Tuple.stub.php
        Map.stub.php
        # Type.stub.php is generated by the parent src/CMakeLists.txt — the
        # only consumers (src/Type.c and the generated Type_descriptor.c)
        # live in the `src` target, and listing it here would create a
        # duplicate add_custom_command OUTPUT (ninja: multiple rules
        # generate Type_arginfo.h).
        Scalar.stub.php
        UserType.stub.php
)

if (PHP_SCYLLADB_ENABLE_CUSTOM_TYPE)
    target_sources(type PRIVATE Custom.c)
    list(APPEND _type_stubs Custom.stub.php)
endif ()

php_scylladb_generate_arginfo(type ${_type_stubs})
php_scylladb_generate_descriptor(type ${_type_stubs})
